images.filename: HAROLD STANLEY, DIRECTOR OF SAFETY FOR THE VIRGINIA-POCAHONTAS COAL COMPANY, LOOKS AT A MAP CROSS SECTION OF MINE ^3... - NARA - 556317.jpg
images.caption: Scope and content:  HAROLD STANLEY, DIRECTOR OF SAFETY FOR THE VIRGINIA-POCAHONTAS COAL COMPANY, LOOKS AT A MAP CROSS SECTION OF MINE #3 AT THE 1,250-FOOT LEVEL IN HIS OFFICE NEAR RICHLANDS, VIRGINIA HE SUPERVISES A SAFETY DIRECTOR AT EACH OF THE SIX MINES WHO IN TURN SUPERVISE SAFETY DIRECTORS FOR EACH MINE SHIFT. IN HIS 21 YEARS IN THE MINES HE WORKED AT ALMOST EVERY JOB. HE TRAINS THE MINE SAFETY TEAM AND HAS THE POWER TO CLOSE DOWN ANY SECTION OF THE MINE AT ANY TIME. HE REPORTS DIRECTLY TO THE COMPANY PRESIDENT
